reason: Provides a native OCR tool and runtime skill for parsing long documents into Markdown, with Baidu Cloud and local OpenAI-compatible provider modes plus GUI configuration.

summaries.zh: 用于通过百度云或本地兼容 OpenAI 的服务识别图片及多种文档，并将长文档解析为 Markdown。
summaries.en: Parses images and multiple document formats into Markdown using Baidu Cloud or a local OpenAI-compatible service.

capabilities: Processing images, PDFs, OFD, Office, and text documents
Uploading selected files or URLs to Baidu Cloud
Sending local file content to a configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Configuring providers, endpoints, models, limits, timeouts, and result storage
